title: My projects
intro: A project is one thing you are teaching the computer to recognise. Each one keeps its own classes, photos and trained model.
empty: You have no projects yet. Make one and start teaching.
namePlaceholder: For example: fruit or not fruit
nameTooLong: That name is too long — 60 characters at most.
deleteBody: This removes the project, its classes, all {{count}} photos and its trained model from this device. Nothing was uploaded anywhere, so this cannot be undone.
anonymousBody: Everything works, and nothing will be saved to an account. Your projects stay in this browser on this device — clearing your browser data removes them.
restoreBody: "{{name}}" was made on a different device. Your photos and trained model stay on the device that captured them, so they are not here. You can start a fresh copy with the same classes.
